MANDARIN CHINESE — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MANDARIN CHINESE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading Aloud ● Fluency ● Pronunciation ● Articulation.

   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading Aloud ● Fluency ● Pronunciation ● Articulation.
